S.FORM: = Tkijig = Gaga mniq Hwareyseyn Syorinsyang ka alang Tkijig. 219 sapah ka kneegu na sapah, 684 hiyi ka kana knhbragan na hiyi. Tnpusu seejiq o mangal 60% niqan 410 hiyi sp, rahuq na uxay tnpusu seejiq o mangal 40% niqan 274 hiyi koia. Kana ka kleegan seejiq ga, Truku 50%, Amis 4%, Tayal 3%, Bunun 1%, Saysiyat 1%, ni rahuq na o 2%. Hangan alang Alang Tkijig Tukubeycu na alang Tkijig sunca pa kiya ka kari balay qcurux ka dungus niya; dungus na u qqahan daw mdhu mtkray bay mi nniqan uka lnluwan. Nniqan niya Nyusan Kareyngko Bsuring go Congte cwen. Knlbangan Hnruwan hidaw pa msdalih Taypingyang, tudaya u lmutuc alang Hejn, dqras tuhunac u msdalih Yayung Riwu, wa mniq Sapah btasan Congte dqras hnruwan hidaw ya bay 200 mi 300 m. Nniqan lnglingay Mbrnux Quri ppanan rulu ◎Mriq nanaq rulu: Tay 9 seyng Congte twan 179k. ◎Tapa kisya: Hnruwan hidaw seyng eyki Congte. ◎ Tapa Basu: Tapa Hwaryeyn kyun, eyki Kareyngko-Congte, kiya ka dhuq alang Tkijig. Ppwaluk tyeyncu patas qtan alang Teyncu patas pkla nniqan alang. Klwanan sediq Seejiq Truku. Sduwi na kari saya Skari kari Seejiq Truku, skari kari Telu. Snlhayan snhiyan Kiristokyo: Kumu Kineyng Kiristo Cyoro Kyokay. Teyngskyo, SingYasu kyokay. Pnyahan alang Alang Tkiji niyi pa pnrdingan bay cbiyaw han pa, mnneniq Sapah pyasan Tkijig pryaxan hidaw nbuyas ddwiyaq baraw alang Tkijig, pnhyuwan ya bay 190 kngkawas brah na cida. Kngkawas 1926 cida, spuda pngalan kari alang dmudul thdil dhuq tuhunac sapah pyasan ya bay 300m mi 400m. Nhana miyah qduriq Taiwan hini ka Kokominto seyhu pa, alaw ini ttuku ka ddiyun qsiya, hbaraw balay ka wada thdil dhuq msdalih Congte kwancucan muda phiyu alang, hangan alang u kiya ka Tkijig. Mniq kngkawas 1951 na bwihur beyhing ka miyah smliq, wada sliqan ka alang mi, spuda seyhu ka muda dmudul, musa thdil hnruwan hidaw sapah btasan Dungan mi, dmuwi smudal hangan. Quri pplahan mi sanan rmiwaw Pusu tmiyu nniqan: ◎ Qlhangan kongweyn Truku, Ddoras Cingswey, Bnaqi Ucilung Tkijig, Ksanan elu Tkijig. ◎ Pnhuyu nyusan Sapah Pyasan Tiping Congte.
